stories.title: Supreme Court allows use of citizenship database ahead of midterms

en.title: Supreme Court allows use of citizenship database ahead of midterms
en.summary: The Supreme Court authorized the Trump administration to use a federal citizenship database to verify voters before the midterm elections.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets Trump administration use SAVE database for now

en.title: Supreme Court lets Trump administration use SAVE database for now
en.summary: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court permitted the Trump administration to use a controversial database to review state voter rolls for potential noncitizens.

stories.title: Supreme Court Allows Expansive Voter Screening Tool Ahead of Midterms

en.title: Supreme Court Allows Expansive Voter Screening Tool Ahead of Midterms
en.summary: The Supreme Court cleared an expansive voter screening system despite concerns from critics about privacy risks and improper voter purges.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows Trump administration to use expanded database for potential voter purges

en.title: Supreme Court allows Trump administration to use expanded database for potential voter purges
en.summary: The Supreme Court authorized the Trump administration to expand a federal citizenship database and encourage states to purge voters from registration rolls.

stories.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks

en.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
en.summary: The Supreme Court has permitted the use of a data system that was modified by Trump officials, despite a lower court finding it violated federal privacy protections and mistakenly identified U.S. citizens.

en.title: Powerful nor'easter to bring more flooding to Northeast; Hawaii braces for Hurricane Nolo
en.summary: A strong nor'easter is expected to bring flooding and severe winds to the East Coast, while Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii with potentially catastrophic flooding.

en.title: Nor'easter Could Bring Heavy Rain, Winds, and Flooding to East Coast
en.summary: The Northeast, including New York and Boston, faces a forecast of heavy rain, gusty winds, and flooding this weekend.

stories.title: Nor’easter set to hit East Coast today and continue through weekend

en.title: Nor'easter set to hit East Coast today and continue through weekend
en.summary: Millions of Americans prepare for a rare multiday nor'easter bringing rain, wind, and flooding to the Northeast starting Friday.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW say some reporters denied access to state dinner at White House despite judge's order

en.title: CNN, MS NOW say some reporters denied access to state dinner at White House despite judge's order
en.summary: CNN and MS NOW reported that some of their reporters were prevented from attending the state dinner featuring President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House on Thursday night.

stories.title: Administration asks Supreme Court to allow swift deportations to 3rd countries

en.title: Administration asks Supreme Court to allow swift deportations to 3rd countries
en.summary: The administration requested the Supreme Court to immediately lift a lower court order blocking rapid deportations of immigrants to third countries.

stories.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow ‘third country’ deportations for now

en.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow 'third country' deportations for now
en.summary: A lower court blocked a deportation policy that transferred thousands of migrants to countries where they lack citizenship.

stories.title: WATCH: Millions of people on alert for powerful Nor'easter along East Coast

en.title: WATCH: Millions of people on alert for powerful Nor'easter along East Coast
en.summary: A powerful nor'easter storm is expected to impact the East Coast this weekend, with millions of people under alert. Coastal areas are already experiencing effects from the approaching storm.

stories.title: Gold Futures Pick Up As U.S. Dollar Eases

en.title: Gold Futures Pick Up As U.S. Dollar Eases
en.summary: Gold futures rose following a four-session decline as the U.S. dollar weakened and oil markets awaited developments in U.S.-Iran diplomatic negotiations.

en.title: Oil Futures Cautiously Lower With Eyes on U.S.-Iran Diplomacy
en.summary: Oil futures declined as markets carefully evaluated ongoing diplomatic efforts aimed at reaching a U.S.-Iran agreement regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

en.title: Don't Fall for Bond Funds That Say They're Beating the Market
en.summary: Active bond funds often claim to outperform benchmarks, but underlying risks frequently account for their reported returns.

stories.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Pull Back

en.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Pull Back
en.summary: U.S. natural gas futures declined after recovering from earlier losses tied to a TC Energy pipeline disruption in West Virginia.

stories.title: Eurozone Bond Yields Fall as Oil Prices Decline; U.S. Treasury Yields Stabilize

en.title: Eurozone Bond Yields Fall as Oil Prices Decline; U.S. Treasury Yields Stabilize
en.summary: U.S. Treasury yields held steady near multiyear highs as markets reflected expectations of substantial Federal Reserve interest rate increases, while eurozone bond yields fell alongside declining oil prices.
